# Third-party files

`recipeadqa/` holds unchanged files of RecipeADQA, licensed under the Apache License 2.0 (`recipeadqa/LICENSE`, `recipeadqa/LICENSES/Apache-2.0.txt`, `recipeadqa/NOTICE.md`), in their original relative paths:

| File | Used by |
|---|---|
| `code/common/qa/constraint_search.py`, `code/common/io.py` | The ingredient beam search that narrows Recipe requests to at most 25 answers; the configuration names it as `recipe_search_module` |

The RecipeADQA data, which depend on Recipe1M, are not included.
